name: Gift Scratch Card by FreeGiftZone.in
author: Reena Sahu

sections.description:
Gift Scratch Card by FreeGiftZone.in is an interactive scratch card plugin for WordPress that lets you display gift codes in a fun, engaging way.
Create groups of scratch cards or display individual gift cards using custom shortcodes. Customize each card with your own image, gift code, text color, font size, and more.

Check our website for demo: FreeGiftZone

Features:
✔️ Create multiple groups of scratch cards
✔️ Display individual gift cards using shortcodes
✔️ Customize card image, gift code, font size, and text color
✔️ Secure and lightweight plugin

External Services

This plugin does not send any user data to external services.
Users can set their own gift card image URL within the plugin settings.

Contact

Website: FreeGiftZone.in
Email: reenasahusm@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the folder “scratch-card-by-freegiftzone” to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. In the admin panel, navigate to “Scratch Cards” to configure scratch card groups.
  4. Use the shortcodes:
    • [scratch_cards] or [scratch_cards1], [scratch_cards2], … for groups.
    • [scratch_card group="1" card="1"] for individual gift cards.
sections.faq:
How does this plugin work?

The plugin creates interactive scratch cards that reveal gift codes when scratched. Users can configure card images, colors, and font size in the settings.

Is any data sent externally?

No. This plugin does not send or collect any user data.

Can I customize the scratch card design?

Yes, you can customize gift card images, text color, and font size through the plugin settings.
